g.text: One genus starting on one night
8 days after full moon, 27% of the month

The 12 genera with 40+ nights, of 48 recorded. Waves smoothed by about a day, so they spill past the frame; percentages count real nights. Pocillopora (cauliflower corals) split by sea after seeing the data.

Gaps between genera mostly reflect recording sites (shuffling labels within reefs: p = 0.25 without Eilat). Records show when people looked. Some start times are approximate. Sources: Baird et al. (2021), Bouwmeester et al. (2021).
Eleven genera peak in the week after full moon and start around sunset.
Pocillopora spawns by day, and in the Red Sea at new moon.
Most coral genera share one timetable. Pocillopora does not
